metcon.name: Partner Workout
metcon.description:
3 rounds for time
400m run together
30 KB Snatches 24/16kg
6 rope climbs
6 wall walks
Partition as required
RX+ KB @ 32/24
scale rope climb to partial height rope climb or pull from ground
Big hinge on KB, but keep tight and punch up
Hollow position on wall walk
WW - reps start and finish with chest on the ground

hypertrophy.reasoning: Today hammers shoulders, traps, and anterior chain; target posterior chain and pulling muscles for balance.

Rig

30sec e/s PVC Shoulder Opener
5 PVC Around the Worlds each way
5 PVC Pass Throughs
10 Band Row → Rotate → Press
5e/s World’s Greatest Stretch
10 Air Squats
30 Handstand Hold on wall or Plank
10 Lighter KB Snatches
Jog as a team 150m
2 Rounds:
Gymnastics
5 Scap Pull-Ups
1 Partial Wall Walk or Full WW
1 Partial Rope Climb

siri_text: Saturday's workout. Metcon: Partner Workout. Rounds for Time: 400m run together, 30 KB Snatches 24/16kg, 6 rope climbs, 6 wall walks, Partition as required. For hypertrophy, focus on back (lats), hamstrings, biceps.
